## Proposals versus decisions

The original findings proposed comparison/projection for row-level change (R1), explicit code-version labels (R2), a separate pipsystem orchestrator (R3), and a pipload access adapter (R4) (`notes/FINDINGS.md:49-84`, output commit). They also logged mismatches such as GDP readback, missing validation gates and competing work-selection authority (lines 86-100). Neither the proposals nor the mismatches authorized implementation.

The [confirmed M1 record](../../.cg-docs/brainstorms/2026-10-07-m1-code-orchestration-and-storage-decisions-confirmed.md), lines 132-169 at the output commit, selects automatic fingerprints (R2), orchestration in pipdata (R3) and pipload as the access adapter (R4). The [integrated design](../../SYSTEM_DESIGN.md), lines 194-205, 305-311 and 353-361 at pipsystem `dcfd90671a25fd048162aead88e4674d3ec90e10`, preserves R1 as Open. Thus the explicit-label and separate-orchestrator proposals remain historical, not operative.
